// diagnostic

E1133

`{callee}` needs a Set stored as bits, and `Set<{element}>` is not one.

What

`{callee}` needs a Set stored as bits, and `Set<{element}>` is not one.

Why

Only a Set of an enum with 1 to 64 cases, no payloads and no type parameters is stored as one bit per case.

Fix

Use such an enum as the element, or read the Set with `to_list()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1133: tests/ui/set_bits_refusals.stderr.

    |                  ^^^^
 Why: Only a Set of an enum with 1 to 64 cases, no payloads and no type parameters is stored as one bit per case
 Fix: Use such an enum as the element, or read the Set with `to_list()`

Error [jet.FlagValueNotOneBit]: Case `Flag.Mixed` has value 3, which is not one bit
  --> tests/ui/set_bits_refusals.jet:20:21
    |
 20 |     print(Set<Flag>.from_bits(1) == .None)
    |                     ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `bits()` and `from_bits` map each case of a `#Specified` enum to its own value, so each value must be a single bit
 Fix: Give the case a power-of-two value, or remove `#Specified` so the cases take bits in declaration order
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1132
